title: Learning Where to Trust: Reliability-Guided Expert Routing and Velocity Gating for 3D Deformable Registration
abstract: arXiv:2610.36672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deformable image registration relies on accurate anatomical correspondences. However, explicitly coupling local matching reliability with spatial context selection and deformation update strength remains insufficiently explored in learning-based registration. This challenge is particularly pronounced in homogeneous, weakly textured, and severely deformed regions, where ambiguous matches may induce erroneous deformation updates. We propose ReliMorph, a reliability-routed symmetric framework for 3D deformable registration that couples correspondence assessment with spatial context selection and update strength.Local correlation distributions characterize correspondence ambiguity using shared anatomical features with modality-specific adaptation. These reliability cues guide spatial expert fusion and gate residual velocities during coarse-to-fine refinement. Updated inverse-inconsistency feedback guides routing and gating at finer pyramid l

translated_title: 学习信任何处：面向三维可变形配准的可靠性引导专家路由与速度门控
translated_abstract: 可变形图像配准依赖于精确的解剖结构对应关系。然而，在基于学习的配准方法中，将局部匹配可靠性与空间上下文选择及形变更新强度进行显式耦合的研究仍然不足。这一挑战在均质、弱纹理和严重形变的区域尤为突出，在这些区域中，模糊的匹配可能导致错误的形变更新。我们提出了ReliMorph，一个用于三维可变形配准的可靠性路由对称框架，它将对应关系评估与空间上下文选择及更新强度相耦合。局部相关分布利用具有模态特定适配的共享解剖特征来刻画对应关系的模糊性。这些可靠性线索引导空间专家融合，并在由粗到细的精细化过程中对残差速度进行门控。更新后的逆不一致性反馈在更细的金字塔层级上指导路由与门控……
tldr: 提出ReliMorph框架，利用局部相关分布评估匹配可靠性，并以可靠性线索引导空间专家融合和残差速度门控，从而提升三维可变形图像配准在弱纹理、严重形变区域的准确性。
en_tdlr: ReliMorph couples local correlation-based matching reliability with reliability-guided expert routing and velocity gating to improve 3D deformable image registration in homogeneous, weakly textured, and severely deformed regions.
